title: TrailGenic Walking Conditioning Dataset
description: Canonical aggregate plus selected-session TrailGenic conditioning module for standardized Foundation walking. It does not expose raw telemetry.
correction_notice: Heart-rate drift values were corrected on 2026-08-18. Prior drift values and derived interpretations are superseded. Drift is descriptive and is not a measure of metabolic flexibility.

selected_sessions.interpretation: Descriptive single-session result under the recorded protocol and environmental context.

records.mechanism: At approximately matched distance, the HR-per-mile proxy describes average cardiovascular cost per mile without establishing a causal fitness mechanism.

aggregate_finding.definition: average heart rate divided by distance in miles
aggregate_finding.interpretation: Lower values at comparable distance are consistent with lower average cardiovascular cost in this subject; temperature, pace, sleep, hydration, and repeatability remain relevant.

methodology.metric_formula: HR-per-mile proxy = average heart rate / distance in miles
methodology.comparison_frame: longitudinal comparison across 22 fasted flat walking sessions at approximately matched distance
methodology.claim_boundary: Conditioning tracking only. HR drift and HR-per-mile are descriptive and do not establish metabolic flexibility, biological age, causality, or clinical efficacy.

claims: The best observed HR-per-mile proxy was 30.3 versus a 34.7 baseline at approximately matched distance.
Corrected HR drift averaged 2.07%, with a median of 2.25% and a range from -3.0% to 6.5%.
All 22 published sessions were recorded as recovery-ready; this is an observational label, not clinical clearance.
This dataset is a conditioning signal and does not compute or imply biological age.
